## Traffic Impact Analysis

```{r}
library(readxl)

appA <- read_excel("impactdata.xlsx", sheet = "Appendices", range = "A3:D23",
                   col_names = c("demand", "flow", "speed", "los"))
appB <- read_excel("impactdata.xlsx", sheet = "Appendices", range = "A29:F32")
appC <- read_excel("impactdata.xlsx", sheet = "Appendices", range = "A38:D40")
```

```{r}
appA
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(appA) + 
  geom_point(aes(x=flow, y=speed, color=los, size=demand)) + 
  scale_color_brewer(palette='Spectral', direction=-1) + 
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(x='Flow', y='Speed', color='Level of Service', size='Demand', title="Appendix A")
```

```{r}
appB
```

```{r}
appC
```

### AM/PM level of service by highway

```{r}
n_am_los <- appA[[which(appA$flow == 11200/8 & appA$speed == 56), "los"]]
n_pm_los <- appA[[which(appA$flow == 11200/8 & appA$speed == 56), "los"]]
s_am_los <- appA[[which(appA$flow == 12000/6 & appA$speed == 50), "los"]]
s_pm_los <- appA[[which(appA$flow == 10800/6 & appA$speed == 45), "los"]]
w_am_los <- appA[[which(appA$flow == 6000/4 & appA$speed == 35), "los"]]
w_pm_los <- appA[[which(appA$flow == 6400/4 & appA$speed == 39), "los"]]
```

### Trips generated from new office development

Total trips generated from new office development:

```{r}
# The numbers come from the modal data plots
am_new_trips_generated_total <- 1000*1.45*0.87
pm_new_trips_generated_total <- 1000*1.5*0.85
```

Trips generated by direction from new office development:

```{r}
n_am_newtrips <- am_new_trips_generated_total * appC[[1, "Share N"]]
n_pm_newtrips <- pm_new_trips_generated_total * appC[[2, "Share N"]]
s_am_newtrips <- am_new_trips_generated_total * appC[[1, "Share S"]]
s_pm_newtrips <- pm_new_trips_generated_total * appC[[2, "Share S"]]
w_am_newtrips <- am_new_trips_generated_total * appC[[1, "Share W"]]
w_pm_newtrips <- pm_new_trips_generated_total * appC[[2, "Share W"]]
```

### New PM demand, flow, speed, and L.O.S. on western highway generated from new office development

```{r}
#Existing Demand
w_pm_existingdemand_perlane <- appA[[which(appA$flow == 6400/4 & appA$speed == 39), "demand"]]
w_pm_existingdemand_total <- w_pm_existingdemand_perlane * 4

#New Demand
w_pm_newdemand_perlane <- w_pm_existingdemand_perlane + (w_pm_newtrips/4)
w_pm_newdemand_total <- w_pm_newdemand_perlane * 4

#New Speed
#The 2500 is a rounded down version of w_pm_newdemand_perlane
w_pm_newspeed <- appA[[which(appA$demand == 2500), "speed"]]

#New Flow
w_pm_newflow_perlane <- appA[[which(appA$demand == 2500 & appA$speed == w_pm_newspeed), "flow"]]
w_pm_newflow_total <- w_pm_newflow_perlane * 4

#New LOS
w_pm_newlos <- appA[[which(appA$demand == 2500 & appA$speed == w_pm_newspeed), "los"]]

```

### Adding a new western highway lane

```{r}
old_pm_capacity <- 2000 * 4
new_pm_capacity <- old_pm_capacity + 2000 #since it's 2000 capacity per lane
demand <- w_pm_newdemand_total
# We have 5 lanes now
new_pm_demand_perlane <- round((demand/5), digits = -3)
new_pm_speed <- appA[[which(appA$demand == new_pm_demand_perlane), "speed"]]
new_pm_flow <- appA[[which(appA$demand == new_pm_demand_perlane, appA$speed == new_pm_speed), "flow"]]
```
